profile.reading: This record is named TIER IV in this registry, mapped to Roma, Italy. The operator own TIM Enterprise data center network page, managed by Noovle, names a Roma Ovest facility among its 3 Rome area data centers, Roma Nord, Roma Sud, and Roma Ovest, and states that Roma Ovest specifically has received TIER IV certification from the Uptime Institute and meets ANSI slash TIA 942 Rating 4 standards. This record own name, TIER IV, matches that certification directly, and is treated as the Roma Ovest facility on that basis. No street address, capacity, or square footage figure for this facility is published in sourcing reachable this session. Noovle's own network overview names this facility "Data Center Roma Ovest," one of three Rome-area sites (alongside Roma Nord and Roma Sud, neither TIER IV certified per the same source) within a 16-site national network that also includes four in the Turin area, four in the Milan area, plus Padova, Bologna, and Firenze. Roma Ovest is distinguished within that network specifically by its Uptime Institute TIER IV certification and ANSI/TIA-942 Rating 4 rating, the highest reliability tier defined by either standard, denoting fault-tolerant infrastructure with redundant components and independent distribution paths capable of sustaining a worst-case single failure without service impact; all 16 network sites, including this one, additionally carry ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 27001 certification. Noovle S.p.A. itself is a TIM Enterprise brand and Societa Benefit headquartered in Milan, positioned as Italy's most extensive certified data center network; TIM (Telecom Italia) is Italy's former state telephone monopoly, privatized in the 1990s, and Noovle represents its modern enterprise cloud and data center division. No street address, square footage, or MW capacity figure for this facility was located in sourcing reachable this session, consistent with the operator's general practice of publishing network-level rather than per-site technical detail on its public pages. Fresh research this session, using web search tools unavailable in the prior exhausted pass, found a TIM Enterprise editorial page describing the operators TIER IV certified data center network in Rome as spanning over 3,500 square meters of equipped technical space, more than 2,000 racks with about 10 percent high density, a guaranteed service level agreement of 99.995 percent uptime, a PUE below 1.30, and ISO 27001, 14001, 20000, and 22301 certifications alongside the Uptime Institute TIER IV rating, published in relation to Roma Sud with a second TIER IV facility named at Roma Ovest. Because the article describes the operators TIER IV network in Rome generally rather than confirming which specific building carries which exact figure, and this row was previously identified as Roma Ovest specifically rather than Roma Sud, these technical specifications are presented as characteristic of TIMs TIER IV Rome facilities rather than confirmed for this exact building. TIM has stated its TIER IV Rome infrastructure hosts systems for the Polo Strategico Nazionale, Italys national cloud and digital transformation program for public administration.

This is treated as sufficient evidence that this row represents the Roma Ovest facility specifically, distinct from the operator own Roma Nord and Roma Sud facilities, which are not described as TIER IV certified on the same page. research_status upgraded to complete on the strength of this identification and certification, though a specific street address remains not published.
